objective: Resolve the adaptive OneEnd coverage and correctly directed EigenX/CEST-to-EndRing reduction gaps with two complementary zero-run producer packets and one frozen review round.

candidates.title: Adaptive OneEnd coverage portfolio
candidates.uncertainty: Can any of three materially distinct public interfaces answer every adaptive bounded-OneEnd query with exact support, success, and polynomial total cost?
candidates.positive_decision: A J1--J4 survivor advances only to a separately ranked reduction/construction batch.
candidates.negative_decision: Record each interface's earliest scoped obstruction, keep the canonical problem open, and rerank a materially distinct recipient mechanism.
candidates.next_action: IDEA GENERATOR: produce the bounded three-interface packet, then stop for snapshot and independent review.

ambiguities.question: May high-mass success under D_ER stand for every adaptive query?
ambiguities.resolution: No; require a transcript-conditional coverage theorem or label the bridge broken/open.

ambiguities.question: Does a per-curve witness existence theorem give a public uniform algorithm?
ambiguities.resolution: No; construction, dependencies, representation, and cost must be uniform and explicit.
ambiguities.basis: opening contract and public-only dependency control

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: A source-matched typed bridge with transcript-conditional success, complete cost, no forbidden advice, and holds verdicts on J1--J4, or a reviewed quantifier/collision obstruction for a named interface.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: Preserve the exact missing lemma or source and do not admit the interface.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Worst-case, per-instance, distributional, and transcript-conditional guarantees remain distinct; unsupported upgrades are inconclusive or breaks as defined by the owning joint.
peripheral_exclusions: No scientific, implementation, formalizer, benchmark, or parameter-selection runs.
No hidden path, orientation, ideal, torsion, tag, ring witness, or non-uniform advice.
No PKE wrapper, parameter selection, security theorem, novelty, practicality, deployment, or universal impossibility claim.

resource_estimate.dominant_cost: Source-grounded symbolic construction and quantifier audit
resource_estimate.complexity_hypothesis: No asymptotic improvement is claimed; the target is a polynomial interface proof or scoped obstruction.
resource_estimate.sharding_plan: Independent from the EigenX obligation producer; shared artifacts only after snapshot.
resource_estimate.stop_rule: At most three interfaces and one review round.

candidates.title: EigenX six-obligation and reduction audit
candidates.uncertainty: Can the frozen CEST/EigenX transcript support a correct-direction extractor of a complete EndRing basis, and what is the exact O1--O6 status?
candidates.positive_decision: A complete, independently reviewed reduction plus O1--O6 discharges permits a later construction decision; no automatic promotion.
candidates.negative_decision: Name the earliest scoped reduction or construction obstruction and retain CEST-XFER-KI as a separate assumption.
candidates.next_action: IDEA GENERATOR: produce the six-obligation and typed reduction packet, then stop for snapshot and independent review.

ambiguities.question: Does a complete EndRing solver that decrypts establish an EndRing security reduction?
ambiguities.resolution: No; it is the reverse implication and only an attack route.
ambiguities.basis: scheme-construction O5 and frozen CEST proof-search map

ambiguities.question: May CEST-XFER-KI be treated as EndRing hardness?
ambiguities.resolution: No; it remains a separate intermediate game until a reviewed reduction establishes the relation.

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: A typed full-basis extractor on the exact game distribution with quantified loss, or a reviewed observable-fiber/quantifier counterexample blocking a named reduction family.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: Keep the obligation open with its exact missing theorem or algorithm.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: One evaluator, one transfer point, OneEnd, and complete EndRing outputs are never conflated.
peripheral_exclusions: No new scheme identity; EigenX is CEST-PKE.
No security, QROM/PQ, CCA, novelty, practicality, deployment, performance, or universal impossibility claim.

resource_estimate.dominant_cost: Typed reduction search and six-obligation audit
resource_estimate.complexity_hypothesis: No asymptotic security or performance claim is made.
